content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"Both ICAR Junior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences and ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences are awarded on the basis of merit in All India Competitive Entrance Examinations with concurrent admission to Master's and Ph.D. degree programs respectively at Agricultural Universities (AUs), which collectively include Central Universities having faculty of agriculture such as Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) [E01][E02].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"Both ICAR-JRF (PGS) and ICAR-SRF (PGS) are awarded with concurrent admission to Agricultural Universities (AUs)","evidence_ids":["E01","E02"]},{"claim":"Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) is listed as one of the Central Universities having faculty of agriculture under the Agricultural Universities (AUs) category for both schemes","evidence_ids":["E01","E02"]}]}
